newsitem.title: USA: Greyhound Lines June passenger miles rose.
newsitem.headline: Greyhound Lines June passenger miles rose.

text.p: Passenger ticket sales for Greyhound Lines Inc rose 5.1 percent for the second quarter of 1997 and 9.6 percent for the first six months of 1997 at its 198 largest electronic reporting locations.
June ticket sales increased 3.7 percent over last year, the company said.
The number of passengers traveling on Greyhound increased by 5.5 percent in June, 5.4 percent for the second quarter and 9.4 percent for the first half of the year.

The yield, or sales per passenger mile, fell 2.1 percent in June, 3.3 percent for the second quarter and 3.2 percent for the first half of the year, reflecting an increase in promotional pricing and an increase in average trip length, it said.
